_comment: Per-sprite render metadata for game.js's images{} map. anchor.x/anchor.y are fractions of the RAW image's own width/height (can go below 0 or above 1 -- the anchor editor no longer clamps this, since a tightly-cropped sprite's true ground-contact point can fall outside its own pixels). scale corrects sprites with baked-in padding. _room holds the plate's grid: originPx is grid (0,0)'s pixel location; axisX/axisY are the screen-space vector moved per +1 step along each grid axis, independently measured (not assumed symmetric) via tools/anchor_editor.html's 3-point calibration. tileW/tileH are kept only as a legacy fallback/reference.
